caption: The video captures a top-down view of a black gongfu tea tray resting on a wooden surface. Its slatted drainage grid and gold-trimmed edges frame a still arrangement of vessels. A hand at the upper edge holds a dark clay teapot tilted over a fair-cup whose white interior cradles a strainer. A thin, unbroken stream of liquid pours from the teapot's spout into the pitcher, already mid-flow at the opening and continuing without interruption to the end. Throughout the pour the teapot and the holding hand drift vertically: the body rises toward the top edge around the middle, stretching the stream into a longer thin arc, then settles back nearer the pitcher so the pour shortens, with another slight lift toward the end. The spout keeps its alignment over the strainer while the tilt angle stays roughly constant. The small dark tasting cup, two painted white bowls, the cream horse-motif jar, the utensil holder and the tray itself stay in place while the overhead framing holds steady.
relations: Tilted teapot spout aligned over the strainer sustains an unbroken thin stream into the fair-cup.
Vertical drift of the teapot and hand stretches the stream into a longer arc, then shortens it as they settle.
The tasting cup, two white bowls, cream jar, utensil holder, and tray remain fixed while the pour continues.
Holding hand maintains roughly constant tilt angle as the body rises toward the top edge then returns nearer the pitcher.
